notes: The Monday to Friday Mass card is now called Monday to Friday Mass Schedule, and a new Status column shows whether each Mass is happening now, has not started yet, or has ended.
new: A Status column in the Monday to Friday Mass Schedule shows Happening now, Not started yet or Ended for each day. It updates by itself while the app is open.
Days with no Mass, like a No Holy Mass day or a school break day, show No Mass.
changed: The card is now called Monday to Friday Mass Schedule.
On Saturday and Sunday the table shows the coming week, so every day reads Not started yet.
